steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Hey, D.D.D. You're finally awake.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Waking up after catching some Z's is pretty normal, no?

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: You crashed straight into bed the moment you got back last night, though. That really had me worrying.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: How are things looking outside?

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: If you're asking about the city, it's just like before. Bustling.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: I heard a lot of people talking about what happened yesterday while I was having breakfast. Didn't seem like they care much, though.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Well, things already got pretty watered down.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Mayor Candela's amazing.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: With all that went down, nobody could've seen that coming.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: I was really shocked when I saw it on TV too.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: I've never seen anyone calm things down like that.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: And quite a few people actually went and fought the terrorists.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: I was right there. It just felt so bizarre.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Some of the terrorists were going straight after Ms. Candela, and they were really close.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: But she didn't even seem to care about that. All she cared about was getting the drones to the ship so she could get a good look at the action there.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: She was just standing, pointing at the screen and the sea while talking to the other spectators around her.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: It was like nothing that was happening was real.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Then, those two girls showed up.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: It was like them being there dragged everything back to reality.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: It was so... so exciting!

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: So you want to create something.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Ahaha, you know me well.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: How long have we known each other?

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Yeah, that's right. I wanna create. I want to write a song that to document the fear, gratefulness, confusion that I feel right here right now.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: This is a song I'm writing for myself, but it's got to do with them.

steps.name: Mizuki
steps.text: On its own, this city is a decent place.

steps.name: Mizuki
steps.text: Leithanien's musicals, Columbia's movies, and Bolívar's coffee. I've got to experience everything I wanted to try.

steps.name: Mizuki
steps.text: But the people here are so boring. I got tired of playing with them about halfway through the competition.

steps.name: Mizuki
steps.text: If I'd known this is how it would turn out in the end, I would've boarded the ship with Miss Ch'en after I made sure she was alright. I probably could've helped her that way.

steps.name: Mizuki
steps.text: Oh well, I'm starting to be sick of this city. Maybe I'll check out wherever Miss Ch'en's going.

steps.name: Mizuki
steps.text: I bet there are just as many nice people like her where she comes from.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's way too reckless of you, Swire.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Uh-huh, yeah yeah yeah, okay, yeah. Fine, I got it. Why do I have to sit here and listen to you reprimand me again?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I left the L.G.D. in your hands, and you...

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Oh, I know what I'm doing.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Besides, what about you? I thought you jumped ship to Rhodes Island to be an operator there, but here you are on a holiday!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm... Fine, you're right.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Come on, keep going. Why did you stop? I don't even remember the last time you two had an argument.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: We had one last time I went to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Eh, anyway, we're all here, and we got everything wrapped up. We should put all the unpleasant things behind us and have some fun instead.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Right, Ch'en?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: *Sigh*... right.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What's wrong? Are you still thinking about yesterday?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Yeah. I might've received the one honor that I don't ever want to receive in my entire life.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Haha, true. To be honest with you, even I thought that was pretty nasty.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But it happened nonetheless.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ch'en, there's not a whole lot in the world that goes exactly as you want but can still be called an absolute win for all parties concerned.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Okay, enough. If we're just gonna sit here and talk, we might as well go get some shopping done and stuff our faces with food to cheer ourselves up.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Let's go. I'm paying for lunch.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Now where's that stupid rat?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I think I saw her heading out early in the morning. Not sure where, though.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I have an inkling where she might be. I'll go find her.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Let me know when you do.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hmph, she's been hiding from me since last night. She's dead as soon as I find her, I'm telling you.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I'm leaving you in charge of the place once I'm gone.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You remember everything I taught you, right?

steps.name: Casino Boss
steps.text: Of course. You can rest assured it's in good hands.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What are you two chatting about?

steps.name: Casino Boss
steps.text: Oh, Miss Ch'en. The boss is lecturing us right now.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Don't tell her that. She might arrest you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm not a cop anymore.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I've never seen such a big busybody of a tourist.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Leave us.

steps.name: Casino Boss
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Do you need something?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I doubt you looked everywhere just to have a drink with me.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What if I tell you that's what I'm doing?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Then... let's have a drink.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I know the President of the Lungmen Young Entrepreneurs' Association to be a decisive, resolute person, strict on both herself and others.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And now I've finally seen her decisiveness for myself.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: And the L.G.D. Special Inspection Unit Chief I know is an impartial person who shows criminals absolutely no mercy.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I finally had the pleasure to meet her.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Did Wei Yenwu send you here?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Lady Fumizuki sent me here as his representative.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: At first, I didn't understand why, but I figured it out when I saw you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You aren't mad?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Not at all. This is an opportunity for me.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The Rat King's daughter won't necessarily become the Rat King. But that also means she could be.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: So that's why you helped him?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I won't answer that, Hui-chieh.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Because I'm not like you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You want to say I abandoned Lungmen.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The thought did cross my mind at first, but not anymore.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: This is a simple declarative sentence. I am not like you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That kind of grates on my ears.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: That's your problem.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoh.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hey, did you find that stinking rat yet?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: She's right here.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Where are you?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: In a bar on Coastal Highway 26.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: The 26? Perfect. I see a decent place there. I'll send you the address. You two head on over and get us a table.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: And drag that ngong gau lou syu there if you have to. Don't let her get away.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You heard her.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: *Sigh*... Will that woman ever be less of a pain?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Shall we go?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's quite a lot of people on the beach.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The ship's one of the city's symbols. Now that it's sunk, people here are bound to be curious.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The cruise ship, huh?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It doesn't matter what you think about it. We are the ones who blew it up. That's the truth.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: We should be thankful that Lady Candela wrote it off in exchange for our prize money.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: To be precise, you blew it up.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You had a better idea?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hmm? Who's that over there...?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Ernesto?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Miss Ch'en, Miss Lin.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What are you doing here?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Ms. Candela spared everyone except my father. Most of us are being exiled.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: She's only letting me stay because of my service in the past few years. Of course, I'm most definitely losing my job.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You're thinking of staying?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: No, I'm planning to leave.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Rafaela and I are trying to figure out where to go. I spent the whole night thinking and still don't have anything. That's why I'm sitting here, gazing out at the sea to see if it gives me any ideas.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Rafaela is the little girl?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: That's right. She's the daughter of my father's old war friend, tío Pugh. He died rescuing my father from prison and entrusted her to him before he died.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Have you two given killing me here on the spot any thought?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't have the right to pass judgment on you, yet.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Had you succeeded, I'd kill you the moment we saw each other again. As for right now... I'll pass.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Haha, it's just like you two to say stuff like that.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Miss Ch'en, Miss Lin, I suppose, in Yan, they'd call me an unfilial son?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We could also say you betrayed your father in the name of righteousness, but you aren't there yet.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Hahaha, you're right. There wasn't anything righteous about what I did.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: The thought of betraying my father never crossed my mind during this operation, though.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Do you remember what I told you on the ship, Miss Ch'en? That wasn't a lie.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I'm not sure if this has crossed your mind during your time here.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I know very well what this city was built on top of.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: However, whenever I look at the skyscrapers and the blue sky up above, I can't help but feel that there is some sort of legitimacy to it.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I can't think of it any other way.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But you choose to leave now.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: To tell the truth, if it wasn't for you two, I think I would willingly stay here and work under her.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: But your words left me bewildered.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: You two are foreigners. Perhaps, elsewhere, things could have been different.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Phew... It feels much better now that I got that off my chest.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Thank you for not bludgeoning me to death the moment you saw me, much less listening to me talk about all this.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It's all a matter of perspective.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Well, I'm done bothering you. I will likely be around for a little longer. Please don't hesitate to come to me if you need me for anything.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I can't help him...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Neither can... What do you mean?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I just think it's a pity to leave him wallowing in misery like that.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll think about it...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hey, Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hello.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: We were just leaving the city hall, and Ms. Swire here invited us to lunch with you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I see. How did your talks with the mayor go?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Thanks to you, we've played a role in this little incident. The mayor didn't think twice before she agreed.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's just like her to do that.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Finally caught you, you stupid rat!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I wasn't running away. Perhaps you've got a few loose screws, Beatrix.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You're the one who's got loose screws!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Most girls aren't so jealous of their friends going on a holiday that they follow them there in secret.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I'm built different!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Right, Missy said we'll be going shopping in the afternoon. Grabbing souvenirs, too, while we're at it. Ch'en, Miss Lin, how about it?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: The stupid rat has to come.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Fine, I don't have much else to do.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Let's go get lunch, then.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Hey, you four, come. Pose for me.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: It just occurred to me this could make a really great picture. I'll snap one for you. Something like a memento of your holiday.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Sounds lovely. Hey, ugly rat, it's time for a picture. Get in.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: *Sigh*... Whatever.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Haha, it's not often that the four of us get to spend time together. How about it, Ch'en?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Alright. 3, 2, 1, cheese—!

a.text: Dossoles's handground coffee is known for its unique aroma, and the finest of the finest has a particularly rich fragrance.
Even before you take a sip of the coffee, you are blessed with its aroma, and while your first sip may seem bitter, you will be greeted with its true, fine flavor soon thereafter.
It is tart, but not overly so. It is fragrant, but it does not overwhelm. Above all, it leaves a rich aftertaste. Even the most demanding critics find no faults in its many qualities.
Some Leithanian nobles even compete against each other in the procurement of Dossoles's finest coffee, and whoever that has the most has the definitive standing in their social circles.
A small cup of this rare coffee is now in the Chief of Lungmen Wei Yenwu's hand, its aroma wafting in the air.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Are you reading Yühsia's report on her trip to Dossoles?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Yes, I am. It's been a while since I last saw Candela. It sounds like she hasn't changed. A crazed woman, as always.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: You dare say you're not like her?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Of course I'm not like her.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: From what the Messengers I sent there told me, Yühsia and our little Ch'en did really well.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I am not quite sure why the young lady of the Schwire family and Hoshiguma were there, however.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: They did a wonderful job, indeed.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: But my guess is they weren't very happy about it themselves.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You said Candela wouldn't dare to hurt them. I agree.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: But they are still too young to know how to endure her generosity.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: That woman doesn't see right and wrong. Results are the only thing that matters.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: So you're beating around the bush, trying to tell me I should never have sent the two of them there?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: No, quite the opposite. You're right. There was no harm done in letting them see the sights there.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: My, it's not often you say something so nice.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: In that case, let me show you something nice as well.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: It's a photo that Yühsia brought back.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Look, isn't it wonderful? All of them are so young, so full of energy.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: That used to be us. Do you remember?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Of course I remember.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I'll sleep better knowing Ch'en is doing well.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I'll frame this picture and cherish it forever.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: As long as you're happy.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Yenwu.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Is our little Ch'en going to come back?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I'm glad.
